verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has a documented Exports API that creates exports by type and date range. It covers customers, screening, cases, profiles, payment screening, transaction monitoring and transactions, delivered via a short-lived download URL. Transaction data is explicitly exportable as CSV. However, the file format of the other export types is not documented, and nothing shows a complete account-wide export or an exit/deletion process. missing for 10: documented open formats for all export types, proof that exports cover all data (e.g. configurations, audit trails), documented account offboarding/data deletion, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Create a new export by selecting an export type and a start and end date.
CUSTOMER_SCREENING, CUSTOMER, SCREENING_AND_MONITORING_CASES, PROFILES, PAYMENT_SCREENING_CASES, TRANSACTION_MONITORING_CASES_AND_ALERTS, TRANSACTIONS.
It is possible to select and export transaction data as a CSV file to use outside the ComplyAdvantage platform as needed.
